decisions.reason: The coupling protection cap is a very low-cost accessory that costs almost nothing to keep, so this cheap option should stay open even though it no longer appears visibly online.

After four years the car transporter line's niche demand is fairly clear and it uses shared production, but its several models carry higher holding costs than an accessory, so the risk of withdrawal is moderate while keeping it remains justified.
The high covers build cheaply on existing trailer platforms and were featured on the home page, so they preserve upside at low cost and do not yet warrant abandonment.
